styles.sprite: Single video-game sprite asset. Clean stylized 3D render, soft neutral studio lighting, matte materials, gentle ambient occlusion, no blown-out speculars. Fixed camera: high three-quarter view, about 55 degrees above the horizon, looking down at the object. The object is centred, fills roughly 85% of the frame, and is completely isolated on a flat, uniform, pure saturated green (#00FF00) background. Absolutely no cast shadow, no ground plane, no reflection, no vignette, no text, no watermark, no logo, no brand mark, no packaging. Bold chunky silhouette with strong internal value contrast — this asset is displayed at roughly 48 pixels tall, so no fine detail, no thin lines, no small text, no busy texture.
styles.tile: Seamlessly tileable texture swatch, flat orthographic top-down view, perfectly even lighting edge to edge, no vignette, no directional shadow, no perspective. The pattern must repeat continuously with no visible seam when tiled left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Photographic material realism but simplified — readable when scaled down. No text, no watermark, no logo, no objects sitting on the surface.
styles.layer: Wide cinematic matte-painting layer for a 2D game background, painted flat with no camera lens effects. Even exposure, no lens flare, no vignette, no depth-of-field blur, no text, no watermark, no logo, no visible airline branding. Horizon line runs across the exact vertical middle of the frame. Colours slightly desaturated and cool so foreground gameplay elements read on top of it.

A white airport baggage tug towing two open flatbed baggage carts loaded with a few generic suitcases, seen flat from the side. Completely unbranded, no text. Wide horizontal composition.
